integrity: Mathematical proof and source-limited self-review; classical q-polynomial identities and existing inversion machinery explicitly credited. Finite checker tests are not substituted for proof.
limitations: Fixed Gaussian parameter 0<p<1, fixed unit-spaced integer sites and all-one data; no uniform parameter limits. The older Gaussian Toeplitz inversion paper could contain implicit coverage not excluded by its accessible abstract. Independent validation not performed.
title: Alternating finite-size boundary correction for Gaussian lattice interpolation
